D142_shock_recovery.domain: separate STK or selected-option contract/generation, never mix shares/contracts

D142_shock_recovery.baseline: last complete reconstructed state before shock; positive spread and positive selected displayed depth
D142_shock_recovery.shock_onset: first ordered post-baseline state with selected depth <= 0.70*baseline_depth AND spread >= 1.25*baseline_spread
D142_shock_recovery.recovery: first ordered state strictly after shock with selected depth >= 0.90*baseline_depth AND spread <= 1.10*baseline_spread

D142_shock_recovery.tie_and_reset: ordered receipt then scoped unique ingestion sequence; ambiguous equal keys refuse; 316/317/reset/gap/generation change refuse

D142_shock_recovery.intermediate_state_rule: A complete eligible state meeting only depth recovery or only spread recovery is not a completed recovery: continue examining later ordered states within the same observation window. D144_smart_direct_matching.window: both complete standing books at synthetic receipt cutoffs; max absolute inter-source receipt skew 0.250 seconds; exact sequence and versioned pair identity; no fabricated source-event time
D144_smart_direct_matching.metrics: Per pair: SMART price minus direct price, with identical explicitly declared native quote units on both source books; SMART displayed size minus direct displayed size in shares for stock or contracts for options. Retain both source/unit/venue/MPID lineages. In this synthetic option scenario a premium price is USD per underlying share, not total USD per option contract; any separately requested contract premium requires the explicit configured contract multiplier. Never infer a multiplier or mix premium-per-share with premium-per-contract.
